During the Year, Benxi Hengkang has completed the work of product carbon footprint accounting and greenhouse gas emission statistics, and summarized the relevant qualitative and quantitative data into corresponding reports, laying a good foundation for the medium and long-term construction of green factories. In December 2021, Benxi Hengkang was recognized as a green factory in Liaoning Province.
